title: The Sleep Boundary

claims.wording: Five-fold increase in suicide risk at 3am after adjusting for who is awake.
claims.note: Tubbs 2024: five-fold suicide and eight-fold homicide between 2am and 3am. Do not place fold-risk numbers on public SNF pages.

claims.wording: Build a sleep boundary: name nocturnal vulnerability, anchor wake times, protect hours after midnight.
